gaps.title: ESLint is not configured
gaps.detail: Nothing enforces anything yet. This is the first thing bootstrap installs.

gaps.title: No TypeScript
gaps.detail: Types are the cheapest rule set there is, and the type-aware lint tier cannot run without them. `ever-better migrate` walks it one file at a time, dependencies first.

gaps.title: No formatter
gaps.detail: Formatting must land before linting starts, or the first drain PR is a diff nobody can read.

gaps.title: No test runner
gaps.detail: Draining warnings finds bugs. Without a runner there is nowhere to pin them.

gaps.title: No dead-code detection
gaps.detail: knip reports unused exports and files. Report-only at first; a counter later.

gaps.title: No duplication detection
gaps.detail: jscpd is what turns 'this feels repetitive' into a number that can only go down.

gaps.title: No CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md
gaps.detail: Draining is done by agents. Rules that live only in your head produce a different fix every session.

gaps.title: Missing package scripts: format, lint, build, typecheck
gaps.detail: CI runs scripts, not commands. A gate with no script behind it cannot be enforced.

gaps.title: CI does not run on macos
gaps.detail: Path handling and file watching break per platform, and only per platform.

gaps.title: CI does not run lint
gaps.detail: The rules are configured but nothing runs them on a pull request.

gaps.title: CI does not run `ever-better check`
gaps.detail: A baseline is only a ratchet if something rejects a regression. Thorough CI that never runs the gate enforces nothing, and looks identical from the outside.

gaps.title: 14 files over 600 lines
gaps.detail: These are the split-and-DRY backlog. Knowing the count now makes the limit a choice.
